title: A slow kb_backlog command does not hold the kb MCP server's other calls
goal: kb_backlog cost answers in a time the server's other calls can wait, or the server answers other calls and notifications/cancelled while it runs

run:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import time, kb_mcp
s = time.time(); kb_mcp.kb_backlog({'command': 'cost', 'args': ['SP-ttgcpf7o']}); el = time.time() - s
print('kb_backlog cost seconds:', round(el, 1)); sys.exit(0 if el < 10 else 1)

clauses.clause: kb_backlog cost answers in a time the server's other calls can wait, or the server answers other calls and notifications/cancelled while it runs

notes: review of SP-ttgcpf7o, S3 note: kb_backlog cost took 38-48 s in-process on a loaded host, the same as the CLI; the stdio server serves one request at a time and does not act on notifications/cancelled.
